description: Plan 9.10 / X-MB4 acceptance: a reaction-wheel attitude actuator on a spherical pivot, in 3D. GroundSpatial -> Pivot (Spherical3D, compliant: kt = 1e9 N/m, bt = 5e3 N s/m) -> Link (FixedTransform3DNeutral, body CoM 0.2 m below the pivot) -> Body (RigidBody3D: m = 2 kg, J = (0.06, 0.05, 0.04) kg m^2). Four pyramid wheels (axis tilted atan(sqrt 2) from the body z axis, azimuth 0/90/180/270 deg, so A A^T = 4/3 I), each a RigidBody3D (m = 0.3 kg, J = (1e-3, 1e-3, 2e-3)) on a Revolute3D (kr = 1e5, kt = 1e7) oriented by a FixedTransform3DNeutral, driven by a CurrentControlledDrive (k_t = 0.05 N m/A) through a stiff ElasticShaft. Project library: Allocator (1 ms minimum-norm allocation of a scripted three-axis body torque plus a null-space component lam = 0.01 N m), WheelTap (measured null-space tap) and BodyMeasure (world angular momentum and gravity impulse per body). Two variants: `gravity-off` (g0 = 0, the body spins at (0.3, -0.2, 0.5) rad/s) and `gravity-on` (g0 = 9.81, the body is released 0.5 rad off the vertical).

checks.note: gravity off: the body starts upright (identity quaternion)
the body alone carries H_x = J_x w_x + m (r x v)_x = 0.018 + 0.024 = 0.042 kg m^2/s at t = 0 (spin (0.3, -0.2, 0.5) rad/s about the pivot, CoM 0.2 m below it)
the wheels start at rest relative to the body

world angular momentum about the pivot, component x (body + 4 wheels), H0 = 0.0598 kg m^2/s: gravity off and the pivot wrench has no moment about the pivot, so it is constant while the four wheels exchange momentum with the body; measured max|H - H0| / max|H| = 3.1e-14; tol 1e-9 is the stated bound for the pivot stiffness kt = 1e9 N/m (the error of a compliant pivot scales as 1/kt)
